archiveTitle: Morning Brief | Terranigma returns after 31 years

entries.headline: Dokimon Quest free to keep on Steam for 48 hours
entries.summary: Indie developer Yanako RPGs is offering Dokimon Quest free on Steam for a limited time; add it to your account between August 25, 01:00 and August 27, 01:00 (Beijing time) to keep it permanently. The game is a turn-based monster-collecting RPG inspired by the Game Boy Color era, featuring over 140 monsters.
entries.verification: Opened the specific Steam store page and confirmed it can be added to account for free; AUTOMATON provided the start and end times and described it as a 48-hour offer. The free status and timing were rechecked within this window.
entries.timeNote: AUTOMATON explicitly states the start at 02:00 and end at 02:00 Japan time on August 25 and 27, respectively, which converts to 01:00 Beijing time.
entries.regionLabel: Global / Some regional stores may display differently

mediaAlts.alt: Official Steam store banner for Dokimon Quest, used as the image for the limited-time free-to-keep news.

entries.headline: Blasterbug: Last Bug Standing! launches free on Steam
entries.summary: Dotemu has released Blasterbug: Last Bug Standing! for free, a top-down party action game supporting up to 8 players in local multiplayer. The base game includes 15 characters, 15 arenas, and 5 modes; Remote Play Together enables online co-op, with paid DLC for additional characters and arenas.
entries.verification: Opened the Steam store page and confirmed free-to-play, up to 8-player local multiplayer, 15 characters, 15 arenas, and Remote Play Together; AUTOMATON cross-confirmed the launch status.
entries.timeNote: Steam page shows an August 24 release; AUTOMATON confirmed it was live at 09:29 Beijing time on August 25, using a verifiable time within the window.

mediaAlts.alt: Official Steam store banner for Blasterbug: Last Bug Standing! in Simplified Chinese.

entries.headline: Terranigma officially returns after 31 years, coming to consoles and PC in 2027
entries.summary: Clear River Games and Square Enix have announced a modern version of Terranigma, planned for PS5, PS4, Xbox Series, Switch 2, Switch, and PC (Steam/GOG) in 2027. The Steam page confirms development by Clear River Games Development; this marks the first modern re-release of the 1995 action RPG.
entries.verification: Opened the specific Steam store page and the publisher's official website to verify the title, developer/publisher, and modern re-release; Gematsu cross-checked all platforms and the 2027 window. The Chinese name uses a long-standing common translation, not marked as official.
entries.timeNote: Gematsu published at 14:05 ET on August 24, which converts to 02:05 Beijing time on August 25.

mediaAlts.alt: Official Steam store banner for Terranigma, used as the image for the modern version announcement.

entries.headline: Sanitarium Enhanced announced, classic psychological horror remastered this year
entries.summary: Ziggurat Interactive has announced Sanitarium Enhanced, developed with QUByte Interactive, planned for PS5, PS4, Xbox Series, Switch, and PC in 2026. The new version adds widescreen support, full controller support, Steam Deck optimization, a hint mode, movement speed options, and extra materials from the original development team.
entries.verification: Opened Ziggurat's official product page and the Steam store page to verify the enhanced content, developer/publisher, and 2026 window; Gematsu cross-checked the platform range.
entries.timeNote: Gematsu published at 14:35 ET on August 24, which converts to 02:35 Beijing time on August 25.

mediaAlts.alt: Official Steam store banner for Sanitarium Enhanced.

entries.headline: Ninja JaJaMaru: Yokai Night Parade reveals gameplay and platforms, coming in 2027
entries.summary: City Connection has officially revealed the gameplay and platforms for the series' completely new title: it becomes a top-down hack-and-slash action game with over 300 equipment types, special 'Yokai Night Parade' battles, and base decoration and growth, planned for PS5, Switch 2, and PC (Steam) in 2027.
entries.verification: Opened City Connection's official page and the specific Steam store page to verify the developer/publisher, 2027 window, core gameplay, and platforms; AUTOMATON cross-checked the announcement details. The Chinese name is a common translation.
entries.timeNote: AUTOMATON published at 04:54 Japan time on August 25, which converts to 03:54 Beijing time; the official Steam page was opened around the same time.

mediaAlts.alt: Official Steam store banner for Ninja JaJaMaru: Yokai Night Parade.

entries.headline: Alien Breed 35th Anniversary Collection announced, includes six classic titles
entries.summary: Commodore and Antstream, in collaboration with Team17, have announced Alien Breed 35th Anniversary Collection, featuring six Commodore series titles with additions like twin-stick controls, save states, filters, rumble, online co-op, Horde mode, and a virtual museum. PC, PS5, and Xbox Series versions are set for September 24, with Switch arriving in fall 2026.
entries.verification: Opened Commodore's specific announcement and the Steam store page to verify the number of included titles, features, partners, and release plans; Gematsu cross-checked the announcement time and platforms.
entries.timeNote: Gematsu published at 15:10 ET on August 24, which converts to 03:10 Beijing time on August 25.

mediaAlts.alt: Official Steam store banner for Alien Breed 35th Anniversary Collection.
